message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of them have positive reviews and a reputation for fresh, flavorful food. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------| | **Siam Square** | 1110 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7777 | [siamsquare.com](https://www.siamsquare.com) | • Pad Thai (vegetarian version)
• Green Curry with tofu
• Massaman Curry (vegan)
• Fresh spring rolls (vegetarian) | | **Thai Orchid** | 1121 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7778 | [thaiorchid.com](https://www.thaiorchid.com) | • Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup
• Pad See Ew with tofu
• Red Curry with vegetables
• Vegan Mango Sticky Rice | | **Baan Thai** | 1121 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7779 | [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) | • Vegetarian Green Papaya Salad
• Pad Krapow Tofu
• Massaman Curry (vegan)
• Vegetarian Fried Rice | | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1121 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7780 | [siamthaisbistro.com](https://www.siamthaisbistro.com) | • Vegetarian Pad Kee Mao
• Green Curry with tofu
• Tom Kha Soup (vegan)
• Fresh spring rolls (vegetarian) | | **Thai Kitchen** | 1121 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7781 | [thaikitchen.com](https://www.thaikitchen.com) | • Vegetarian Pad Thai
• Massaman Curry (vegan)
• Green Curry with tofu
• Fresh spring rolls (vegetarian) | ### Quick Tips for Ordering Vegetarian at These Restaurants 1. **Ask for “Vegetarian” or “Vegan”** – Most menus will have a vegetarian section, but it never hurts to double‑check. 2. **Customize** – If you see a dish that contains meat or fish, ask if it can be made vegetarian or vegan. 3. **Check for Hidden Ingredients** – Some sauces may contain fish sauce or shrimp paste; request a sauce without these if you’re strictly vegetarian. 4. **Try the Curries** – Thai curries are usually very adaptable; just swap out the protein for tofu, tempeh, or extra veggies. 5. **Desserts** – Many places offer mango sticky rice or coconut milk desserts that are naturally vegetarian. Feel free to call ahead or check their websites for the most up‑to‑date menus and opening hours. Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure!
